plugins.name: claude-code-status-bar
plugins.description: Warns you before a rate limit or auto-compact, not after. A pure-bash Claude Code status bar (no jq, Node optional) for macOS, Linux, and Windows: usage pacing + burn-rate forecast, context warnings, live activity, cost, git, and 8 themes.
